# AGENTS Guide
## Project Snapshot - Language: Java (single-source style). - Build system: none configured (`pom.xml`, `build.gradle`, and Gradle wrapper are absent). - Entry point: `src/Main.java` uses a top-level `void main()`. - IDE metadata: `agendador.iml` defines `src/` as the only source root.
## Current Architecture - The codebase is currently a single-file app (`src/Main.java`) with linear console output flow: 1. print welcome message 2. iterate from 1 to 5 3. print each value - There are no service layers, modules, persistence, HTTP endpoints, or external integrations yet.
## Run and Debug Workflow - Primary verified run command from project root: - `java src/Main.java` - IntelliJ workflow is valid for this repo shape (single source root in `agendador.iml`). - If you introduce a build tool (Maven/Gradle), add and document its commands here and treat that as the new default workflow.
## Code Conventions Observed - Keep Java source files under `src/` (matches module source root in `agendador.iml`). - Console output in existing code is done with `IO.println(...)` in `src/Main.java`; keep behavior changes explicit when modifying output style. - Existing code uses the default-package style (no `package` declaration).
## Repository Conventions - Respect ignore rules in `.gitignore` for IDE/build artifacts (for example `out/`, `.idea` metadata, `.vscode/`). - This repository currently has no test directory or test runner; if tests are added, co-locate and document the exact command used to run them.

# Agendador API
API Spring Boot para manipular a tabela `usuario` no PostgreSQL.
## Requisitos - Java 17+ - PostgreSQL com a base `agendador` e tabela `usuario`
## Configuracao da conexao A aplicacao usa estas variaveis (com fallback padrao): - `DB_URL` (padrao: `jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5433/agendador`) - `DB_USER` (padrao: `agend`) - `DB_PASSWORD` (padrao: `troque_esta_senha`)
## Rede corporativa (proxy Maven) Se houver bloqueio para baixar dependencias, edite `\.mvn\settings.xml` e ative o proxy: - trocar `host`, `port`, `username`, `password` - mudar `<active>false</active>` para `true`
## Subir aplicacao ```powershell .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run ```
## Compilar projeto ```powershell .\mvnw.cmd -DskipTests compile ```
## Swagger / OpenAPI Com a aplicacao rodando, acesse: - Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html` - OpenAPI JSON: `http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs`
## Endpoints da tabela `usuario` ### Inserir - `POST /usuarios`
Body: ```json { "nomeUsuario": "Maria Silva", "enderecoUsuario": "Rua A, 123", "celularUsuario": "11999990000", "obsUsuario": "cliente VIP" } ```
### Editar - `PUT /usuarios/{idUsuario}`
Body: ```json { "nomeUsuario": "Maria Silva", "enderecoUsuario": "Rua B, 456", "celularUsuario": "11999990001", "obsUsuario": "atualizado" } ```
### Deletar - `DELETE /usuarios/{idUsuario}`

@ECHO OFF SETLOCAL
set "WRAPPER_DIR=%~dp0.mvn\wrapper" set "MAVEN_VERSION=3.9.9" set "MAVEN_BASE=apache-maven-%MAVEN_VERSION%" set "MAVEN_HOME=%WRAPPER_DIR%\%MAVEN_BASE%" set "MAVEN_BIN=%MAVEN_HOME%\bin\mvn.cmd" set "SETTINGS_FILE=%~dp0.mvn\settings.xml"
if exist "%MAVEN_BIN%" goto run
if not exist "%WRAPPER_DIR%" mkdir "%WRAPPER_DIR%" set "ZIP_FILE=%WRAPPER_DIR%\%MAVEN_BASE%-bin.zip" set "DIST_URL=https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/apache/maven/apache-maven/%MAVEN_VERSION%/%MAVEN_BASE%-bin.zip"
echo [mvnw] Downloading Maven %MAVEN_VERSION%... powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '%DIST_URL%' -OutFile '%ZIP_FILE%'" || goto error
echo [mvnw] Extracting Maven... powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Expand-Archive -Path '%ZIP_FILE%' -DestinationPath '%WRAPPER_DIR%' -Force" || goto error
del "%ZIP_FILE%" >nul 2>nul
:run if exist "%SETTINGS_FILE%" ( call "%MAVEN_BIN%" -s "%SETTINGS_FILE%" %* ) else ( call "%MAVEN_BIN%" %* ) exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
:error echo [mvnw] Failed to prepare Maven wrapper. exit /b 1
